paragraphs.text: Pir and Toothy , known as the Imaginative Rascal and Imaginary Friend respectively, are a Human and Illusion pair from the plane of Kylem .

Pir and Toothy are partners and friends who fight together in Valor's Reach on Kylem. Pir is a young, dark-skinned human who wields a large animal tooth. He has an imaginary friend named Toothy which he can manifest into an illusion that appears as a large blue-colored ooze-like creature with a wide open maw of sharp teeth.
